metadata.title: Global affinity rank does not guarantee target-specific ligand ranking: hierarchy- and representation-aware validation of protein-ligand cheminformatics benchmarks
metadata.description: Rights-bounded code, frozen protocols, predictions, aggregate results, figure-source tables, reproducibility instructions, and audit receipts for the Journal of Cheminformatics Research article 'Global affinity rank does not guarantee target-specific ligand ranking: hierarchy- and representation-aware validation of protein-ligand cheminformatics benchmarks'. BioLiP/MOAD row-level reconstruction, private source-review materials, and model weights are excluded. Original project software is released under MIT (SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT); database-derived fields retain source-specific attribution and terms.
